title: St. Louis John Cochran VA AHU and VAV Replacement
scope: Complete source-bounded Rank 11 ground truth: all-page visual review; project/sheet/scale boundaries; complete 21-row MH601 building steam-trap schedule; MI700 BACnet architecture/controls-symbol context; and explicit source limitations. No formal point list, physical I/O/device counts, topology/addressing, wiring or untranscribed schedule corpus is invented.
reading_notes: MH601 gives a deep steam-trap schedule with tags, service, capacity, pressures, type and size.
MI700 explicitly publishes BACnet architecture and control/sensor symbol definitions.
The supplied set has no conventional tabular point-list matrix.
verification_semantics: The bundle verifier rechecks all retained cells/assertions against independent MuPDF and Poppler evidence and hashes sources/renders; it does not perform takeoff inference.
